verdict.rationale: Muse documents per-connector access choices ("You decide what your agent can see and what it can do"), approved permissions, a secure credential store, and one-time card numbers. These are adjacent access controls and secret storage, not the ability to issue scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The probes found no public API spec or developer surface, so nothing shows Muse issues API keys or tokens of any scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
